I couldn't save this, Hollis. I don't have a way to store notes or preferences: my tools can read files but can't create or edit them, including your notes folder. So I can't promise I'll remember Gate 40 next time.

Your message is still here in our direct messages. If you mention Gate 40 when you ask about a Marrow Agrisupply pickup, I'll go by that. You could also add it to your own notes so it stays on record.
